description_full: BitFuFu Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides digital asset mining solutions in North America, Asia, Africa, Oceania, Europe, and internationally. The company offers cloud-mining and miner hosting services to institutional customers and individual digital asset enthusiasts. It also provides Bitcoin self-mining, mining machine hosting, and other services. In addition, the company leases and sells mining equipment. BitFuFu Inc. is headquartered in Singapore.

financial_summary: BitFuFu Inc. is a micro-cap financial services business with a $157M market cap on $478M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +30% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.

Returns on capital run at 16% against a 9% cost of capital, a 7-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it, and 6% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
Accruals are elevated at +22.8% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin -2.8× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 3.6% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 47% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
